function tagName(node: NodeListOf<HTMLDivElement>): string {
  const first: HTMLDivElement = node.item(0);
  const ancestor: Node = first;
  return ancestor.nodeName;
}
function handleClicks(element: HTMLElement): void {
  element.addEventListener('click', event => console.log(event.clientX));
  for (const child of element.children) console.log(child.tagName);
}
function serializeOptions(options: BlobPropertyBag): string {
  return options.type ?? '';
}
console.log(serializeOptions({ type: 'text/plain', endings: 'transparent' }));
